name: singlet_covariate_adjustment_batch_covariate_removal_expression
title: Batch and donor covariate removal on expression
description: Removes known categorical batch or donor effects from expression with ComBat (log-scale empirical Bayes) or ComBat-seq (negative-binomial counts), keeps protected biological terms in the design, and writes the corrected layer with its per-gene parameters. Use it only when the batch label is correct and every biological variable that co-varies with batch is listed in protect. Do not use it for continuous technical covariates, as a differential expression input, or to correct an embedding.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: combat: log-scale empirical Bayes. combat_seq: negative-binomial counts; needs raw counts.

batch_key.description: obs column with the categorical batch or donor label; each batch needs at least two cells.

protect.description: obs columns of biological variables kept in the design. Set the condition or cell-type column when present.

layer.description: Input layer. Null selects layers/log1p_norm for combat and layers/counts for combat_seq.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without fitting.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

conv.description: Relative-change tolerance of the empirical-Bayes iteration.

hvg_subset.description: Estimate batch parameters on this many highly variable genes, then apply to all genes; null uses all genes.

chunk_cells.description: Cells per chunk in the streaming sweeps; bounds dense memory.

ref_batch.description: Batch kept unchanged, to which others are adjusted; null maps every batch to the batch-free target.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. layers/combat_corrected. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, protect, n_batches, min_batch_cells, eb_iterations, max_relative_change, hvg_subset. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
